title: GRPO 的组内归一化，究竟改变了什么？
summary: 从有限组基线推导到二元策略的精确枚举，拆解减均值、除标准差和动态采样，说明训练信号与生成预算应怎样分别核算。

en.title: What Does Group Normalization Change in GRPO?
en.summary: Finite-group baseline derivations and exact Bernoulli enumeration separate mean subtraction, standard-deviation scaling, and dynamic sampling, connecting gradient signals to generation budgets.

title: 开源算力软件如何改变芯片采购议价权？

en.title: How Does Open Compute Software Change Bargaining Power in AI Hardware?
en.summary: DeepSeek’s Ascend tools, NVIDIA Dynamo, and AMD software optimization reveal how interface reuse can change fixed migration costs—and what makes alternative compute an executable procurement option.

en.title: After model access, who can use experimental feedback? The platform boundary of Lilly TuneLab
en.summary: As TuneLab connects laboratory services and scientific data tools, can model access become sustained learning? The conditions are comparable experiments, usage permissions, and incremental decision value—not partner lists or call counts.

summary: 用闭路做功、截断导数和 Verlet 谐振子的可验算反例，区分势能模型、计算图与积分器的责任；附实际运行的合成检查及真实模型验收协议。

en.title: Why can molecular dynamics drift despite low force error? Conservative forces, smooth cutoffs, and time steps through eSEN
en.summary: Checkable loop-work, cutoff-derivative, and Verlet oscillator examples separate the potential, computation, and integrator. Includes executed synthetic checks and a proposed protocol for real models.

title: 虚拟细胞的评估，为什么要先校准指标？
summary: 从共享偏移与采样噪声推导均值基线为何难以击败，解释技术重复、指标分辨力与测试隔离，并给出兼顾误差、特异效应和检索的验证协议。

en.title: Why virtual-cell evaluation needs metric calibration first
en.summary: Deriving why shared shifts and sampling noise make mean baselines competitive, then separating technical duplicates, metric sensitivity, and test isolation in a protocol that combines error, specific effects, and retrieval.

title: MLA 如何省下 KV 缓存：矩阵吸收与不变的 softmax 温度
summary: 从同一 MLA 的展开与吸收路径推导缓存压缩，解释 RoPE 的障碍、192 与 576 维的缩放陷阱，以及显存节省为何不能直接换成速度。附可复现代数校验。

en.title: How MLA saves the KV cache: matrix absorption without changing softmax temperature
en.summary: Derive cache compression through two paths of the same MLA, examine RoPE and the 192-versus-576 scaling trap, and separate memory savings from speed. Includes reproducible algebra checks.

title: 算力预付款改变了什么？从 Oracle 与腾讯看 AI 扩张的现金时差
summary: 预付款能缩小建设资金缺口，却不会自动消除交付与需求风险。从 Oracle 和腾讯财报出发，区分现金、可用服务、收入与终端回报，并推导需要验收和检验的经济条件。

en.title: What compute prepayments change: Oracle, Tencent, and the cash timing of AI expansion
en.summary: Prepayments can narrow construction funding gaps without automatically removing delivery or demand risk. Oracle and Tencent disclosures help separate cash, usable service, revenue, and end-use returns—and define what to test.

title: 结构正确，为何亲和力仍可能不可靠？从 AlphaFold 3 到 Boltz-2
summary: 从结合态与游离态的统计权重出发，推导姿态不足以确定亲和力的原因，检查 Boltz-2 的标签与单位，并提出防泄漏、带基线的评估方案。本文未运行实验。

en.title: Why a Correct Structure Does Not Guarantee Reliable Affinity: AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2
en.summary: A statistical-mechanical counterexample explains why a pose cannot determine affinity. We examine Boltz-2 labels and units, then propose an evaluation with leakage checks and baselines. No experiments were run.

title: 投机解码为何能保持分布，却未必加速？
summary: 从接受概率、残差校正与三 token 例子出发，推导连续接受长度如何转换为每输出 token 的时间，并检查 KV 缓存、掩码、采样配置与服务评估的边界。

en.title: Why speculative decoding preserves distributions but may not be faster
en.summary: From acceptance probabilities and residual correction to a three-token example, derive how consecutive acceptance converts into time per output token, then audit KV caches, masks, sampling settings, and serving metrics.

title: AI 广告的下一步：意图理解、归因与增量价值
summary: 对话可能让广告更贴近需求，但高意图用户也可能本来就会购买。从 OpenAI 的视觉广告测试出发，拆解增量利润、信任与结算控制，并比较 Google 和百度的经营约束。

en.title: What Comes Next for AI Advertising: Intent, Attribution, and Incremental Value
en.summary: Conversation may improve ad matching, but high-intent users may have purchased anyway. OpenAI’s visual-ad test motivates an analysis of incremental profit, trust, checkout control, and the different constraints facing Google and Baidu.

title: 智能体的商业壁垒：工作流、验证成本与价值分配
summary: 从 OpenAI、Anthropic 与阿里云的公开动作出发，分析智能体如何从模型调用走向企业流程，以及为什么验收、复核和异常处理决定商业价值。

en.title: The Economics of AI Agents: Workflows, Verification Costs, and Where Value Accumulates
en.summary: Public moves by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Alibaba Cloud reveal a contest beyond model calls. Acceptance, human review, and exception handling help determine where business value can accumulate.
